caption:
SWEET & SOUR PANEER 🍍
A sticky, glossy, sweet & sour paneer that takes barely any effort and tastes like takeout at home 🤌🏼

375 calories | 29g protein per serving

Macros are for the paneer + vegetables + sauce only and do not include udon, noodles or rice.
Serves 2

INGREDIENTS
Paneer & vegetables
* 200g paneer, cut into cubes
* 1 medium onion, cut into chunky pieces
* 1 capsicum, cut into chunky pieces
* 100g mushrooms, sliced
* 4–5 cloves garlic, finely chopped
* 1 tsp oil
* Sesame seeds, to garnish

Sweet & sour sauce ( feel free to adjust as per your taste - more/less spicy/salty)
* 200g pineapple juice
* 2 tbsp soy sauce
* 2 tbsp oyster sauce
* 1 tbsp chilli sauce
* 2 tsp vinegar
* 1 tbsp cornflour
* 1/2 cup water
METHOD
1. Add the pineapple juice, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar and cornflour to a bowl. Add water and whisk until completely smooth.
2. Heat the oil in a large pan over high heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 20–30 seconds until fragrant.
3. Add the onion, capsicum and mushrooms and stir-fry on high heat for 3–4 minutes. Keep the vegetables slightly crisp.
4. Give the sauce another good whisk , the cornflour settles at the bottom  and pour it into the pan.
5. Add the cubed paneer directly to the pan and gently toss with the vegetables and sauce.
6. Toss everything together over medium-high heat until the sauce thickens and becomes glossy and sticky.
7. Serve over udon noodles like I did here, or with steamed rice, and finish with sesame seeds.

PRO TIP: Always whisk your sauce again right before adding it to the pan so the cornflour is evenly distributed and you get that gorgeous glossy coating.

Save this one for your next takeout-at-home night ❤️
